entities.summary: Roman Longchamps de Bérier (1883–1941) was a Polish lawyer and university professor, one of the most notable specialists in civil law of his generation and the last rector of the Jan Kazimierz University of Lwów before Nazi occupation. He was murdered in what became known as the Massacre of Lwów professors.

entities.summary: Roman Longchamps de Bérier (1883–1941) was a Polish lawyer and university professor, one of the most notable specialists in civil law of his generation and the last rector of the Jan Kazimierz University of Lwów before Nazi occupation. He was murdered in what became known as the Massacre of Lwów professors.
